description: This file contains utility functions for handling Android boot images, including packing/unpacking ramdisks, generating boot images, and extracting Android version info from boot images. It is part of the 'cuttlefish' project and interacts with various system and project-specific utilities.

methods.name: RunMkBootFs
methods.description: Creates a boot filesystem image from a directory using mkbootfs.

methods.name: ExtractValue
methods.description: Extracts a value associated with a key from a string containing key-value pairs.

methods.name: DeleteTmpFileIfNotChanged
methods.description: Deletes a temporary file if it has not changed compared to a current file.

methods.name: RepackVendorRamdisk
methods.description: Recreates a vendor ramdisk by unpacking, stripping modules, and concatenating.

methods.name: PackRamdisk
methods.description: Packages a ramdisk directory into a compressed archive.

methods.name: UnpackRamdisk
methods.description: Unpacks a ramdisk archive into a directory.

methods.name: IsCpioArchive
methods.description: Checks if a file is a CPIO archive based on its magic number.

methods.name: GetAvbMetadataFromBootImage
methods.description: Extracts AVB metadata from a boot image.

methods.name: UnpackBootImage
methods.description: Unpacks a boot image into a directory, extracting parameters.

methods.name: UnpackVendorBootImageIfNotUnpacked
methods.description: Unpacks a vendor boot image if not already unpacked.

methods.name: RepackBootImage
methods.description: Recreates a boot image with a new kernel and ramdisk, adding AVB footer.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImage
methods.description: Recreates a vendor boot image with a new ramdisk and parameters, adding AVB footer.

methods.name: RepackVendorBootImageWithEmptyRamdisk
methods.description: Recreates a vendor boot image with an empty ramdisk.

methods.name: RepackGem5BootImage
methods.description: Creates a boot image suitable for Gem5, combining ramdisks and boot configs.

methods.name: ReadAndroidVersionFromBootImage
methods.description: Reads the Android OS version from a boot image by extracting metadata.
